book.title: LUK Kamambuno Wakai Luk Muno Boglkwa

content: Tandaglme erikwa pirngi dingwa gugl sungwa
Yesus disaipelma wagle ditongwa, “Taragl kanekane eran yomba tandaglme mina yange sinaglkwa pre plau dina erikwa, ba yomba tandaglme eraglmedi orkwa yombamo i yene yumbun pond inaglkwa.
Ye dumugl kombuglo kande ta ye nungo mina kane kogl pandigl ana piyasi mundi nigl atne endinaglkwa, i wakai kaima, sraglpre, ye gak kembra wagle tandaglme eraglmedi pre bagl nusungwa.
“Yeglpre enene kanpogl siyo, angitn tandaglme eran ene manedi akedu endo. Ana ye nomane yake tenan, ene tandaglme orkwa i kinde kondo to.
Ana ande enge suwarata mina ye tandaglme 7 ere ene tendre ana enge 7 ye erambere ende ikine ene motnara undre dinambuka, ‘Na nomana yake teiwo’ dinan, ene tandaglme orkwa i kindekondo to.”
Pirngi dingwa mambuno
Aposel wagle di Yaglkande teingwa, “No pirngi dumga etn wu kande enano!”

Yaglkande di ikine endungwa, “Ana ene pirngino kembra mastet mongo mereyegl panan, ene endi noglkun i di tenaglkwa, ‘Ene duglon bogl puro indre ana enene endpi mundi nigl suna bogl paiyo’ dimbi ana ene dimere mere erambuka.
Kongun yomba kongun ormere mambunomo
“Ana ene mina suwarata kongunmo yomba ta makan wakungwa mo sipsip sugl moglkwa, ye kongunmo dundungo ende yungugl ungwa enge. Ene eremogl, oglandi wu amedi kaiya mokna no, diteno?

Ana yegl ta manambuka, kongun sugl moglkwa yagle dungwa, ‘Na kaiya mokna akekun ere, ene gatn alap wertre ana kaiyana iyu suro naro ana na kaiya mokna ya nigl komnaiye neimbo ana ene okuwo kaiya ya nigl ninatna.’
Ana kongun yomba dumere orkwa pre ye diwakai yei tenambo? Tamanga.
Ene ama kuno yegl kongun ero ditomere prapra ere kondo ana diyo, ‘No kongun yomba yoko nono konguno pamara ounga.’”
Yesus eremogl yagl 10 kaglande singwa erewakai orkwa
Yesus ende Jerusalem ena pre ana ye Samaria ya Galili makan numamugl sunawom ongwa.
Ye ende yungu epigl ta suna ongwa enge, yagl 10 kaglande singwa wu Yesus tengigl yendre ana ye tau eglke andigl mogl,
ana agle binan bogl dingwa, “Yesus Yaglkande, no mitno goglo.”
Yesus kandre ana ye ditongwa, “Ene ende pindre enene nangino pris wagle ombunodi teiyo.” Ana ye endingo konbauna bange nangino wu wakai ongwa.
Ana ye mina suwarata kangwa nangiye wu wakai ongo ana ende ikine undre, ka kande dindre God dembiyesi mitna imbo endungwa.
Yene yange Yesus moglmara kagle mina sindre ana diwakai yeitongwa. Yaglmo i Samaria kamun nem.
Yesus krapoglkwa, “Yomba 10 prapra wu wakai engura, ana 9 ikra aglo meglme?
Ana yomba ta ende ikine undre God dembiyesi mitna imbo endinaglkwa mango, ana kamun bangeta nem i suwarata moglm kana?”
Ana Yesus ditongwa, “Andigltre, ana endpo, ene pirngi dinga pre kinden wakai orkwa.”
God kingdomo unambuka
Parisi wagle God kingdomo enge aunake unambedi krapogl Yesus teingo, ana Yesus di ikine endungwa, “God kingdomo pendigl ta unan yomba ongumutno mina ta kankraglkwa.
Yomba suwarata yegl dikraglkwa, ‘Kaniyo. Magl igle moglkwa,’ mo ‘Koglo imbo moglkwa.’ Sraglpre, God kingdomo ene mina suna yongwa.”
Ana ye disaipelma wagle ditongwa, “Okuwo enge ta yenan ana ene Yomba Wam ande enge suwarata kanamnedi piraglkwa, ba ene ta kankraglkwa.
Yomba eremogl ene ditenaglkwa, ‘Kaniyo, ye koglo imbo moglkwa,’ mo ‘Ye mangigl moglkwa ya.’ Ana ye enaglmara ene pi dokokriyo.
Yomba Wam engemo yenambuka enge, i kamun potndumere yeglmere, kamun kua mina pogl dungo ana ambuglange mundu si poriya ormere yegl erambuka.
Ba okuna kana ye giu merkinde piran ana yomba epigl erme meglkwa i ye mokono tenaglkwa.
“Noa engemo embriye erimere yeglmere ana Yomba Wam engemo yenan kuno yegl eraglkwa.
Yomba kaiya mokna ne, nigl ne, yagl eremogl ambu ingo te ambu yagl eingo, yegl ere meglkwa enge, ana Noa ende sip mina yungugl ongo, okuwo ana nigl pond undre yomba prapra sigoglkwa.
“Lot engemo i ama kuno yegl. Yomba kaiya mokna ne, nigl ne, ana taragl topo ere, te topo bogl indre, ana kaiya mokna ereyagltre te yungu togl eremeglkwa.
Ba Lot eremogl Sodom kamun kondo endongo, ana donga ya kombuglo salpa de moglkwa kamun sumere yegl, heven ende atne undre ana yomba prapra sigoglkwa.
“Yomba Wam ombunodi unongugl enambuka enge, mambuno kuno yeglmere eraglkwa.
Enge igle yomba ta yungu indaule mogltre ana ende atne pi bona ganamo yungugl yongwa ikrambuka, kuno yeglmere yomba ta kongun mina suna wanmorambuka ye ende ikine yungugl pikrambuka.
Lot embiye mina sragl orkwa i pirmeglmo!
Yomba ta yene kor-morambuka pre akegidi moran, ana wau borambuka, te yomba ta kor-moglkwa kinde kondinan ana kor aimande morambuka inambuka.
Na ene diteinga, enge igle enduwer yomba suwo bogl suwarata mina ugl panambrika, ana ta indre ta kondinambuka.
Ambu suwo plawa akiye noko miur ana ta indre ta kondinambuka.
Yagl suwo kongun ere miur ana i ta indre ta kondinambuka.”
Ana disaipelma wagle krapeglkwa, “Yaglkande, aglo ne?” Ana Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Yomba geglkwa nangino ta yenambara igle kua keglmba wu makai sinaglkwa.”

footnotes.text: Ka i yomba tau yegl yake teingwa, “Piryo, God kingdomo ene mina suna yongwa.”

Erme pirpogl singwa yomba tau epigl i mina ka ikine ta ama pamedi pirkwa. Kamo i yegl, “Yomba suwo kaiya mokno ere yaurara suna wanmiur ana God suwarata indre ana ta kondinan mogl panambuka.” Ka Matyu 24:40 mina pangwa i kano.
